urdu.name: عین النور

faq.question: What does Ainur mean?
faq.answer: Ainur is associated with the Arabic form عَيْنُ النُّور, whose core sense is ainur; light of the eye (compound).

faq.question: What is the origin of Ainur?
faq.answer: Ainur is associated with Arabic. Ainur is a compound of Arabic عَيْن (ʿayn, 'eye') and نُور (nūr, 'light'), used as a female given name in Central Asia.

faq.question: Is Ainur an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form عَيْنُ النُّور is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Ainur an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Ainur can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Ainur a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Ainur should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ainur is a compound name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.question: What does Ainur mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Ainur is rendered عین‌النور and carries the sense عین‌النور، نور چشم.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Ainur, ainur. Script forms are عين النور, عَيْنُ النُّور, عین النور, عین‌النور, ऐनूर.
